_comment: Genericity test run #2. This follows ONLY the SKILL.md process against USSFCU's 7 source systems (Jack Henry/Symitar, MeridianLink, HUNA, SharePoint, Medallia, Member Communications, Regulatory Rules Engine) -- a compliance/financial domain, not healthcare. Compared against the existing upper-ontology concept list produced by the RAIN run, per Step 3 (duplicate detection).

reused_from_existing.note: RESOLVED FINDING: this run originally proposed a new 'Constituent' concept here, flagged for human review because it structurally duplicated C-PATIENT without being the same real-world thing. That review concluded C-PATIENT was itself too domain-flavored -- it has since been renamed to C-CONSTITUENT (see rain-worked-example.json), with 'Patient' and 'Member' both now synonyms of the same neutral concept. Re-running this mapping after the rename produces a direct match instead of a flagged proposal.

reused_from_existing.matched_to: Mortgage application-to-closing lifecycle (HUNA), loan origination lifecycle (MeridianLink)
reused_from_existing.note: Structural definition ('a bounded period for a specific event') genuinely fits a loan/mortgage lifecycle. Held to needs-review because the concept's NAME still carries a healthcare flavor -- flagged for human review rather than silently reused as-is. (Same class of naming issue as C-PATIENT -- worth reviewing 'Care Episode' next.)

reused_from_existing.matched_to: Fair-lending disparity index, TRID on-time disclosure rate, complaint trend (QoQ)
reused_from_existing.note: Clean fit -- the definition itself was never healthcare-specific, so this one genuinely generalizes.

correctly_not_mapped.reason: No analog found in USSFCU's schema. Not force-mapped.

new_concepts_proposed.name: Regulatory Test
new_concepts_proposed.definition: A codified compliance check applied against a population or record (e.g. TRID, ECOA, ESIGN, GLBA).
new_concepts_proposed.review_reason: Genuinely new -- no equivalent existed in the ontology before this run. Clean, unambiguous addition.

new_concepts_proposed.name: Complaint
new_concepts_proposed.definition: A recorded or inferred expression of dissatisfaction from the person being served.
new_concepts_proposed.review_reason: Overlaps partially with C-RISK-SIGNAL (a complaint IS a kind of risk signal). Is this a subtype of Risk Signal or a sibling concept? Left for a human to decide rather than guessed.

coverage_gap_detected.description: The signature USSFCU use case ('how many members carry a specific set of characteristics') requires joining age + geography (Core) with loan pricing (MeridianLink) with a protected-basis determination -- but no single source field represents 'protected basis assessment.' It only exists as a computed join across three sources.
coverage_gap_detected.impact: Same shape of gap as the RAIN compounding-risk finding: a cross-source relationship the raw schema never states explicitly, that the calling application would otherwise have to infer on its own.
coverage_gap_detected.recommendation: Add an explicit 'Regulatory Test Result' relationship connecting Constituent + Regulatory Test + the source records it was evaluated against, rather than leaving the join implicit.

run_metadata.domain: credit union risk & compliance (vs. RAIN's rural healthcare)
run_metadata.note: Re-run after the C-PATIENT -> C-CONSTITUENT rename. Original run (see git history / prior version) sent 3 items to HITL and proposed 3 new concepts; the Constituent finding is now resolved.
